name: zotero
description: Work with Zotero from Codex: search your library, export BibTeX, insert citations, and import references through the Zotero desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: 从 Zotero 中查找文献并添加引用
interface.longDescription: 将 Codex 连接到你的 Zotero 桌面文库，让它能够查找已保存的文献、导出 BibTeX、向草稿添加引用键、按需读取已索引的附件全文，并在你确认后将新参考记录导入 Zotero。
